exposure: composition of the early-life intestinal microbiome
cohort: The study included 393 healthy term infants from whom stool samples were collected at 1 week of age.
finding: There is an association between the bacterial composition of the intestinal microbiome at 1 week of age and the presence of eczema in the first 12 months of life.
mod_finding: CS-born infants with eczema showed distinct microbial profiles (higher Escherichia, Shigella, Enterobacter, Citrobacter; lower Veillonella) compared to CS-born infants without eczema, while vaginally born infants with eczema had higher Bacteroides and lower Streptococcus.
